diagnosis: Customer on unified_auth (confirmed in account data) needs scoped API key rotation guidance, not legacy token reset. Entitled to standard support with 12-hour SLA. No escalation needed—this is a standard how-to within their current auth model.
reply: Since your account is on Unified Auth, API credentials are managed as scoped keys rather than a single account-wide token. To reset, create a new scoped key with the required permissions, move your traffic over to it, and then revoke the previous key. Revocation takes effect immediately with no grace period. You can do this from the API Keys section of your dashboard.
